div.div: عَيَسٌ (S, TA) and ↓ عِيسَةٌ , the latter of the measure فُعْلَةٌ, [originally عُيْسَةٌ.] like صُهْبَةٌ and كُمْتَةٌ, (Lth, O, TA,) Whiteness in a camel, mixed with somewhat of] the red hue termed] شُقْرَة; (S, TA;) [i. e., a reddish whiteness:] or [a dingy whiteness;] whiteness in which is a mixture of clearness with slight darkness: (TA:) [or a yel-lowish whiteness see أَعْيَسُ.]
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
